items.title: Reverse proxy: server ka front door, aur load balancer se fark
items.one_idea: A reverse proxy is a server in front of your servers: clients talk only to it, it forwards each request to a backend and returns the response; it can balance load, terminate TLS and cache, hides the backends, and is a single point of failure. A forward proxy sits in front of clients. A load balancer is one job a reverse proxy can do.
items.spoken_hook: Interviewer ने पूछा: reverse proxy और load balancer में क्या फर्क है?
